blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tokenization is a critical component of the language modeling pipeline, but it is poorly understood. Tokenizers can impact downstream performance, but there is currently mixed evidence about which tokenizer features predict a better language model without requiring a full training run. In this paper, we analyze approximately 200 language models trained on nine different languages. We evaluate both models and their tokenizers and test whether there is a relationship between any proposed intrinsic tokenizer evaluations and model performance, as measured by a wide variety of benchmarks. Despite the quantity and variety of proposed intrinsic tokenizer metrics, we find that none consistently predicts downstream performance across model families, tasks, and languages. This motivates the need for novel tokenizer evaluation metrics and approaches. We propose novel linguistically grounded metric introduced in this work shows that new metrics can capture aspects of tokenizer quality that existing metrics miss, though their predictive power is likely to vary across model families, languages, and tasks.
blocks.zh: Tokenization是语言建模管道的关键组成部分,但理解不足. Tokenizers可以影响下游的性能,但目前有好坏参半的证据表明,哪一种标语特性预测一种更好的语言模型,而不需要全面训练。 在本文中,我们分析了大约200个语言模型,这些模型接受了九种不同语言的培训。 我们评价模型及其标注符,并测试任何拟议的内在标注符评价和模型性能之间是否有关系,衡量标准多种多样。 尽管拟议内在标志性指标数量多而种类多,但我们发现没有任何一个指标能够一致地预测模范家庭、任务和语言的下游业绩。 这促使需要新的象征性评价指标和方法。 我们提议在这部作品中引入新的基于语言的度量衡,表明新的度量衡可以捕捉到现有度量衡错失的标语质量方面,尽管其预测力可能因模型家族,语言和任务而异.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tokenization is one of the earliest steps in the language modeling pipeline and it affects many aspects of the language model, including performance.
Several studies have shown performance differences between models trained otherwise identically, varying only the tokenizer ( Ali et al., 2024 ; Goldman et al., 2024 ; Schmidt et al., 2024 ; Lotz et al., 2025 ) . However, it is not currently well understood which properties of a tokenizer generally lead to better performance.
This prevents language model developers from making principled design decisions for selecting tokenization algorithm, pretokenizer, vocabulary size, etc.
blocks.zh:
Tokenization是语言建模管道中最早的步骤之一,它影响了语言模型的许多方面,包括性能.
一些研究表明,接受过其他相同培训的模型之间的性能差异,仅不同标注剂(Ali等,2024;Goldman等,2024;Smidt等,2024;Loz等,2025)。 然而,目前人们并不十分了解标识器的哪些特性一般能导致更好的性能。
这使得语言模型开发者无法在选择符号化算法,预切器,词汇大小等方面做出原则性的设计决定.

blocks.en: Reliable intrinsic tokenizer evaluations , i.e. metrics derived directly from the tokenizer, would be valuable if they allow researchers to identify more optimal tokenizers before training any language models. Many intrinsic metrics have been proposed, ranging from statistical (e.g. Zipfianness; Lotz et al., 2025 ), compression (e.g. fertility; Rust et al., 2021 ), information theoretic (e.g. Rényi entropy; Zouhar et al., 2023 ), and linguistic (e.g. MorphScore; Arnett and Bergen, 2025 ; Arnett et al., 2025b ) metrics. However, some of these have later been shown to correlate poorly with downstream performance ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ; Cognetta et al., 2024 ; Arnett and Bergen, 2025 ; Arnett et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 可靠的内在标志性评价,即直接取自标志性的衡量标准,如果允许研究人员在培训任何语言模型之前确定更好的标志性评价,将会很有价值。 提出了从统计学(如Zipfianness;Lozz等,2025年),压缩学(如生育率;Rust等,2021年),信息理论学(如Rényi Entropy;Zouhar等,2023年),语言学(如MorphScore;Arnett和Bergen,2025年;Arnett等,2025年b)等多种内在度量. 然而,后来显示,其中一些与下游的业绩关系不佳(Smidt等,2024;Cognetta等,2024;Arnett和Bergen,2025;Arnett等,2025b)。

We use three model suites: two existing suites and a new suite of monolingual models we trained from scratch, which differ only in their tokenizers. We address three related high-level questions:

blocks.en: Given the mixed evidence about which tokenizer metrics correlate with better downstream performance, we calculate the correlation between most proposed tokenizer metrics and downstream language model performance for three different model suites. Many of these tokenizer metrics have been proposed based on empirical evidence from a single language or a small number of languages. We ask whether any of these metrics reliably correlate with downstream performance across tasks, languages, and model suites (Section 6 ). We also propose and test a novel intrinsic tokenizer metric, which we adapt from prior work on entropy-guided segmentation (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于哪一种标语度量度与下游较好的性能相关联的有好有坏的证据,我们计算出大多数拟议标语度量度量度量度值与下游语言模型性能之间对三个不同模型套件的相关性. 许多这些象征性的度量衡是根据单一语言或少数语言的经验证据提出的. 我们问,这些衡量标准是否与任务、语言和模范套间下游业绩有可靠的联系(第6节)。 我们还提出并测试一种新的内在活化剂指标,我们根据以前关于肽-导分化的工作进行调整(第3节)。

blocks.en:
Several proposed intrinsic tokenizer metrics are in apparent conflict with one another. For example, MorphScore measures the extent to which a tokenizer preserves meaningful linguistic boundaries in a word. One way tokenizers can achieve higher MorphScore is by segmenting words into more tokens, so that token boundaries are more likely to overlap with linguistic boundaries. This would affect compression, and it is thought segmenting a word into more tokens (i.e. having worse compression) is associated with worse performance . We ask: are there tradeoffs between features like MorphScore and compression that an optimal tokenizer should balance?
In Section 7 , we characterize the relationships between different intrinsic evaluations. We can then ask whether identifying these tradeoffs helps us understand which combinations of metrics might be more useful for predicting downstream performance. We then test whether any combination of intrinsic metrics may more reliably predict downstream performance.
blocks.zh:
若干拟议内在的标志性指标显然相互冲突。 例如,MorphScore衡量一个标语器在一个单词中保存有意义的语言边界的程度. 一种使符可以实现更高的摩尔phScore的方法是将单词分解为更多的符号,这样使符号边界更容易与语言边界相重叠. 这会影响压缩,人们觉得将一个单词分解成更多符号(即压缩更差)与性能更差有关. 我们问:像"摩菲分数"这样的特性与最佳标致器应该平衡的压缩之间是否有取舍?
在第7节中,我们描述不同内在评价之间的关系。 然后,我们可以问,确定这些取舍是否有助于我们了解哪些指标组合可能对预测下游业绩更有用。 然后,我们检验任何内在衡量标准组合是否能够更可靠地预测下游的业绩。

blocks.en:
It has been asserted that there are certain undesirable language model behaviors that are caused by tokenization. One of these is the lack of orthographic awareness, including the so-called “strawberry problem” ( Silberling, 2024 ; Cosma et al., 2025 ) .
This refers to the fact that even highly performant language models may not have orthographic awareness of their tokens and, as a result, cannot count the number of r s in ‘strawberry.’ Partially in response to this observed behavior, there have been a number of proposed orthographic knowledge and string manipulation tasks, e.g. LMEntry ( Efrat et al., 2023 ) and CUTE ( Edman et al., 2024 ) , which aim to measure how much awareness language models have of the characters in their tokens and their ability to manipulate strings based on that awareness. However, there is minimal theoretical motivation behind these tasks. Do these tasks measure desirable properties of a tokenizer? To address this question, we ask whether performance on orthographic tasks correlates with better performance on other tasks.
blocks.zh:
有人断言,某些不可取的语言模式行为是象征性的所为. 其中之一是缺乏对正文的认识,包括所谓的“草莓问题”(Silberling, 2024; Cosma等, 2025)。
这是指即使表现优异的语言模型也可能不具有正字形意识,因此无法计算出“草莓”中的r s数。 部分针对这种被观察到的行为,出现了一些拟议的正交知识和弦操控任务,如LMEntry(Efrat等,2023年)和CUTE(Edman等,2024年),这些都旨在测量语言模型对符中人物的认知程度,以及根据这种认知操纵弦的能力. 然而,这些任务背后的理论动机微乎其微. 这些任务是否测量了标致器的可取属性? 为了解决这一问题,我们问,正字图任务的执行情况与其他任务的执行情况是否更好相关。

blocks.en: Our main findings are: • RQ1: No intrinsic tokenizer metric reliably predicts downstream performance across model suites, languages, and tasks. While idiosyncratic correlations exist, they do not generalize. • RQ2: Intrinsic metrics are highly redundant, metrics within the same category are strongly correlated, and combining metrics does not improve prediction. • RQ3: Orthographic tasks are only weakly correlated with general downstream performance, raising questions about their role in guiding tokenizer design. Tokenizers are a critical aspect of language model design ( Alqahtani et al., 2026 ) , but it is still not known how to measure whether a tokenizer is suitable for a particular model. Our results motivate new approaches to tokenizer design and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要调查结果是: RQ1:没有内在的标语标语,可以可靠地预测模型套间、语言和任务之间的下游性能。 虽然存在特异性关联,但并不概括. 二. 支助 RQ2:内置度量衡高度冗余,同类中的度量衡密切相关,而结合度量衡并不能改善预测. • RQ3:正字形任务仅与下游的一般性能有微弱的关联,使人们对其在指导活化剂设计方面的作用产生疑问。 Tokenizers是语言模型设计的一个关键方面(Alqahtani等,2026年),但目前还不知道如何衡量一个标语器是否适合特定模型. 我们的成果促使人们采取新的方法来进行象征性的设计和评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Most researchers evaluate tokenizers through intrinsic evaluation: evaluating the tokenizer itself, independent of any model.
Reliable intrinsic evaluation would be valuable because experiments involving training models while varying only the tokenizer can be prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the most widely used intrinsic tokenizer metrics that have been proposed.
blocks.zh:
大多数研究者通过内在评价来评价活化剂:评价活化剂本身,独立于任何模型.
可靠的内在评价将很有价值,因为涉及培训模式的实验,而只有象征性方法不同,费用可能太高。 在这里,我们介绍了已提出的最广泛使用的内在活化剂指标。

blocks.en:
One of the most commonly studied dimensions of tokenizer quality is compression.
Compression is measured in a variety of ways, most often fertility (tokens per word; Rust et al., 2021 ) or bytes per token ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
Higher compression on the test set is associated with better performance in machine translation ( Gallé, 2019 ) . Delétang et al. (2024) show that minimizing a language model’s cross-entropy loss is equivalent to minimizing the number of bits required to compress the data, establishing a direct connection between compression and modeling quality.
But in controlled studies where comparable models are trained with different tokenizers, results generally have not supported this link between compression and performance ( Ali et al., 2024 ; Schmidt et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
活化剂质量最常被研究的维度之一是压缩.
压缩量的测量方式多种多样,最常见的是生育力(每个字的收缩;Rust等人,2021年)或每令牌的字节(刘等人,2025年).
测试集上更高的压缩率与机器翻译上更好的性能有关(Gallé, 2019.). Delétang等 (2024)显示,将一个语言模型的交叉切入损失最小化相当于将压缩数据所需的比特数最小化,在压缩和模型质量之间建立了直接联系.
但是,在使用不同的活化剂培训可比模型的受控研究中,结果一般没有支持压缩和性能之间的这种联系(Ali等,2024; Schmidt等, 2024.).

blocks.en:
Information-theoretic measures have been proposed to characterize the distributional properties of tokenizer vocabularies. Rényi entropy ( Zouhar et al., 2023 ) generalizes Shannon entropy and penalizes unbalanced token distributions, particularly those dominated by a few high-frequency tokens.
Other related metrics include unigram and bigram entropy, which measure the diversity of token usage and contextual variety where, similarly, higher entropy may be more desirable. However, Cognetta et al. (2024) showed that while Rényi entropy captures some desirable properties of a tokenizer, it is not a holistic measure of tokenizer quality. Furthermore, Dagan et al. (2024) find that higher Rényi entropy in fact is correlated with lower performance in code generation. Beyond vocabulary characterization, entropy at character boundaries can identify meaningful linguistic units, a principle used by the Byte Latent Transformer to dynamically segment byte sequences ( Pagnoni et al., 2025 ) , and may help preserve multi-word expressions, an important aspect of tokenizer quality ( Gow-Smith et al., 2022 , inter alia ).

blocks.en:
Tokenizers that preserve the internal structure of words and segment along morphological boundaries are argued to lead to better performance ( Klein and Tsarfaty, 2020 ; Park et al., 2020 ; Vasiu and Potolea, 2020 ; Hofmann et al., 2020 ; Nzeyimana and Niyongabo Rubungo, 2022 ; Libovický and Helcl, 2024 ; Bauwens and Delobelle, 2024 ) .
For example, Bostrom and Durrett (2020) proposed evaluating tokenizers based on their alignment with morphological structure. Subsequent work has further developed morphology-based evaluation criteria, showing, for instance, that derivational segmentation improves model interpretations of complex words ( Hofmann et al., 2021 ) .
But, there are also a number of studies which have failed to find benefits of morphologically aligned tokenization ( Macháček et al., 2018 ; Saleva and Lignos, 2021 ; Choo and Kim, 2023 ; Toraman et al., 2023 ; Arnett et al., 2024b ; Arnett and Bergen, 2025 ; Arnett et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh:
保留形态界限上文字和分块内部结构的切入器被论证为能导致更好的性能(Klein and Tsarfaty,2020;Park等,2020;Vasiu and Potolea,2020;Hofmann等,2020;Nzeyimana and Nyongabo Rubungo,2022;Libovický and Helcl,2024;Bauwens and Delobelle,2024).
例如,Bostrom和Durrett(2020年)提议根据其与形态结构的相接性来评价活化剂. 随后的工作进一步发展了以形态学为基础的评价标准,例如,表明衍生分解改进了复杂词的模型解释(Hofmann等,2021年)。
但是,还有一些研究未能找到形态对等的标志化的好处(Macháček等,2018;Saleva等,2021;Choo等,2023;Toraman等,2023;Arnett等,2024b;Arnett等,2025;Arnett等,2025b).

blocks.en:
Statistical approaches evaluate how effectively tokenizers use their vocabularies and how token usage is distributed.
Measures like vocabulary utilization (the proportion of vocabulary items actually used when encoding a corpus) and type-token ratio (the ratio of unique tokens to total tokens) capture basic aspects of vocabulary coverage and lexical diversity.
Other metrics capture how token usage is distributed across the vocabulary: average (token) rank is the expected rank of a token sampled from a corpus when vocabulary items are sorted by frequency. Limisiewicz et al. (2023) show that vocabulary allocation, which they measure via average token rank and characters per token, has nuanced effects on multilingual performance: higher allocation benefits word-level tasks but harms masked language modeling scores.
Also examining vocabulary frequency distributions, Lotz et al. (2025) propose metrics based on Zipf’s law, which assess whether token frequencies follow the power-law patterns observed in natural language.
In these studies, these metrics correlate more strongly with downstream performance than compression-based metrics, particularly in multilingual settings.
blocks.zh:
统计方法评价象征性工具如何有效地使用其词汇,以及象征性工具的使用如何分布。
词汇使用量(拼接一物时实际使用的词汇项目比例)和类型-托肯比(独有的符与总符之比)等衡量尺度,捕捉了词汇覆盖度和词汇多样性的基本方面.
其他的度量法捕捉到符号使用在词汇中是如何分布的:当词汇项目按频率排序时,平均(token)分级是从某物目中抽取的符号的预期分级. Limisiewicz 等 (2023) 显示,词汇分配,它们通过平均符号等级和每个符号的字符来测量,对多语种的性能有细微的影响:更高的分配效益是单词级任务,但损害掩盖了语言模型分数.
Lozz等人(2025年)还研究了词汇频率分布,根据Zipf定律提出了衡量标准,该定律评估了象征频率是否遵循自然语言所观察到的功率法规律.
在这些研究中,这些衡量标准与下游业绩的关系比压缩衡量标准更为密切,特别是在多语种环境中。

blocks.zh: 4 材料

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We use three suites of models: the models from TokSuite ( Altıntaş et al., 2025 ) ; the models in the paper “Tokenization Is More Than Compression” ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ; henceforth TIMTC); and a suite of models we train ourselves, VISTA.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了三套模型:来自TokSuite(Altıntaş等,2025年)的模型;“Tokenization Is More Than Compression”(Smidt等,2024年;以后称为TIMTC);以及一套我们自己训练的模型,VISTA。

blocks.en:
The TokSuite models ( Altıntaş et al., 2025 ) consist of 14 1B-parameter Llama architecture models with identical training budget and initialization, which differ only in their tokenizers. These models enable us to attribute performance differences to tokenizer characteristics.
The tokenizers are drawn from existing models and feature various vocabulary construction algorithms (BPE, Unigram, WordPiece), as well as both byte-level and subword tokenizers.
Among these models, vocabulary sizes vary substantially, from a byte-level vocabulary of 259 tokens to approximately 250k (most are between 30k–130k).
blocks.zh:
TokSuite模型(Altıntaş等,2025年)由14个1B参数Llama建筑模型组成,培训预算和初始化情况相同,这些模型仅在标注器上有所不同. 这些模型使我们能够将性能差异归结为指示器特征.
标语符取自于现有的模型并具有各种词汇构造算法(BPE,Unigram,WordPiece),以及字节级和子词标语符.
在这些模型中,词汇大小相差很大,从259个符的字节级词汇到大约250k(大多数在30k–130k之间).

blocks.en: The models were trained on a multilingual corpus consisting of 40B tokens of English data from FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) and 15B tokens each of Turkish, Chinese, Italian, and Farsi data from FineWeb-2 ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
In Schmidt et al. (2024) , the authors investigate the hypothesis that the effectiveness of BPE arises primarily from its text compression capabilities.
They release a suite of 54 1 1 1 We used 45 of the available models due to persistent out-of-vocabulary errors that we could not resolve. 350M-parameter models that differ only in their tokenizers, and which vary systematically in their:
(1) vocabulary construction , how the vocabulary is built;
(2) initial vocabulary , the token set used to seed vocabulary construction;
(3) pre-tokenization , rules that restrict or enforce token boundaries; and
(4) segmentation , the algorithm that assigns segmented text into tokens given a vocabulary
(see Appendix B.1 for details). The models are trained only on English data.

This carefully controlled suite—where models differ only in their tokenization choices while sharing identical architecture, training data, and hyperparameters—allows us to isolate the effects of tokenization on downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 这个精心控制的套房,模型只在象征性选择上有所不同,同时共享相同的架构、培训数据和超参数,使我们有可能隔离象征性对下游性能的影响。

blocks.en:
We introduce VISTA ( V ocabulary-size I nvestigation S uite for T okenizer A nalysis), a suite of monolingual models for five languages (English, Thai, Urdu, Amharic, and Vietnamese), which systematically varies vocabulary size using both BPE and Unigram tokenizers.
For each language and vocabulary size, we pre-train a language model based on the LLAMA 1 architecture Touvron et al. (2023) .
The language models are pre-trained using a standard auto-regressive cross-entropy loss.
We train monolingual models with corresponding language-specific tokenizers, with varying vocabulary sizes.
Varying vocabulary size is one way to systematically manipulate tokenizer characteristics like compression ( Arnett et al., 2025a ) and has been shown to impact model performance ( Toraman et al., 2023 ) .

For the 130M parameter models, we used data from fish-food 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/datasets/goldfish-models/fish-food ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , with each language’s training corpus sized to approximately 1 GB × \times its byte premium (or ‘BP’, as discussed below).
Each tokenizer is trained on the equivalent of 300 MB of English data in the corresponding language ( Arnett et al., 2025a ) .
For the larger 350M models, we use FineWeb and FineWeb-2 ( Penedo et al., 2024 ; Penedo et al., 2025 ) , with a Chinchilla optimal ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) 7 billion tokens ( ∼ {\sim} 31 GiB tokenized) for English.
We control for character-encoding efficiency, following Chang et al. (2026) , by normalizing the corpus size according to the byte premium (BP), i.e. the ratio of UTF-8 bytes required to encode content-matched text in a language L L vs. English ( Arnett et al., 2024a ) .
Each non-English language’s training data is further byte premium (BP)-scaled to match: target_bytes = BP × (English ref. bytes) \text{target\_bytes}=\text{BP}\times\text{(English ref. bytes)} , yielding 42–85 GiB of tokenized data depending on the language and vocabulary size (see Table 4 ).
The 130M models are trained for 10 epochs over their BP-scaled sets, matching the multi-epoch regime advocated for smaller monolingual budgets ( Muennighoff et al., 2023 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) . The 350M models are trained for 1 epoch on their BP-scaled Chinchilla-optimal sets, except Urdu which uses 3–4 epochs to compensate for limited FineWeb-2 availability ( ∼ {\sim} 24% of the BP-scaled target). We do not train an Amharic 350M model, because FineWeb-2 contains less than 5% of the data necessary to optimally train a model of that scale. VISTA architecture and training details are discussed in detail in Appendix B.3 .

blocks.en:
We use 27 previously proposed intrinsic tokenizer metrics from the different categories discussed in Section 2 and the two U-statistic metrics we introduced in Section 3 . We list the metrics used in Appendix A and provide additional description of each.
To compute these metrics, we use the tokenizer-intrinsic-evals (TokEval) 6 6 6 https://github.com/cimeister/tokenizer-intrinsic-evals suite ( Meister, 2026 ) , a unified framework for tokenizer evaluation that provides implementations of information-theoretic, morphological, and statistical metrics, among others. For metrics not in the evaluation suite, we implemented them in our own fork (marked with † \dagger in Table 2 , Appendix A ). The fork is available online, linked from our main repository. 7 7 7 https://github.com/AntonioLopardo/tokenizer-metric-multilingual-correlations For test data we use samples from the OSCAR corpus ( Abadji et al., 2022 ) .

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Evaluations
blocks.zh: 4.3 示范评价

blocks.en: To quantify the performance impact of different tokenization processes, we carefully selected a group of downstream task benchmarks. In total, we use 48 distinct benchmarks spanning linguistic acceptability, natural language understanding, commonsense reasoning, world knowledge and question answering, multi-task suites, token-level (orthographic) tasks, and perplexity, across nine languages; the per-suite lists are given in Tables 8 , 9 , and 10 . We use the LM Evaluation Harness Gao et al. (2024) ; Biderman et al. (2024) for evaluation. For the tasks not implemented in the harness, we implemented them ourselves.   This also enabled us to adapt the harness to support custom models, especially the TIMTC models which use non-standardized tokenizers. We selected the benchmarks using a few criteria: first, we chose tasks that were appropriate for the scale of models we evaluate in these experiments (100M-1B parameters). Second, we selected tasks that we expect to show sensitivity to tokenization variation, particularly linguistic benchmarks like BLiMP and other NLU tasks. Finally, we select an additional set of common tasks such as commonsense reasoning and question answering. The full list of benchmark tasks is provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 5 Tokenizers Do Affect Model Performance
blocks.zh: 5 切除模式性能

blocks.en: Before addressing our research questions, we describe the results from the tokenizer and model evaluation. We release the raw tokenizer evaluation metrics and language model benchmark scores on GitHub 8 8 8 https://github.com/AntonioLopardo/tokenizer-metric-multilingual-correlations and the full model evaluation results are presented in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 在讨论我们的研究问题之前,我们首先要描述一下标语和模型评估的结果。 我们公布GitHub 8 8 8 https://github.com/Antonio Lopardo/tokenizer-meterm-多语种-corrections上的原始标码器评价指标和语言模型基准分数,完整的模型评价结果见附录D。

blocks.en:
Consistent with previous work, we find that across multiple model suites, many evaluations, and several languages, the tokenizer used to train a model significantly impacts performance.
The range of aggregate performance was 4% with individual task performance differing by up to 50% (for ANALOGICAL, Wijesiriwardene et al., 2023 ; the lowest performance was 37% and the highest was 89%).
blocks.zh:
与之前的工作一致,我们发现,在多个模型套件,许多评价,以及几种语言中,用于训练模型的标语器对性能有重大影响.
总体业绩范围为4%,个别任务业绩差异可达50%(ANALOGIAL, Wijesiriwardene等人,2023年;最低业绩为37%,最高业绩为89%)。

blocks.en:
Some of these differences may be driven by the vocabulary size, which also impacts the number of embedding parameters, and therefore model size. We find a moderate positive correlation between vocabulary size and average performance for these models ( ρ = 0.64 , p < 0.01 \rho=0.64,p<0.01 ).
But vocab size doesn’t account for all differences. XGLM, BLOOM, and Gemma all have vocab sizes of around 256,000. The XGLM tokenizer yields some of the best performance, while Gemma leads to more average performance in aggregate. While these models differ in many aspects, this suggests that other tokenize features besides vocabulary size may drive model performance more.
blocks.zh:
其中一些差异可能由词汇大小所驱动,这也影响了嵌入参数的数量,并因此影响了模型大小. 我们发现这些模型的词汇大小和平均性能之间有适度的正相关关系(ρ=0.64,p < 0.01\rho=0.64,p < 0.01).
但花样大小并不代表所有差异。 XGLM, BLOOM,和Gemma都拥有约256,000个活字大小. XGLM的表示器产生出一些最佳的性能,而Gemma则导致在总和上更平均地性能. 虽然这些模型在许多方面有所不同,但这表明,除了词汇大小之外,其他象征性特征可能会推动模型的性能。

blocks.en: After evaluating TIMTC on our own set of evaluations, we find that there are differences in performance between the models in the suite, as found in Schmidt et al. (2024) . Across the different tokenizer conditions, average performance differed by up to 6.5% across models. The maximum range in performance per task was 37%.
blocks.zh: 在对TIMTC进行我们自己的一套评价后,我们发现套房中的模型在性能上有差异,见Smidt等人(2024年). 在不同的象征性条件下,不同模型的平均性能相差可达6.5%。 每个任务的最大性能范围为37%.

blocks.en:
The VISTA models also exhibit differences in performance depending on tokenizer, with differences in aggregate performance of 4%-26%, depending on the language. Unlike the TokSuite models, however, we do not find any significant relationship between vocabulary size and model performance ( p = 0.407 p=0.407 ; results in Appendix D.3.1 ).
One reason for this difference could be that while TokSuite tokenizers differ in many aspects, VISTA tokenizers only differ in vocabulary size.
blocks.zh:
VISTA模式也根据标语显示性能差异,总性能差异为4%-26%,取决于语言. 然而,与TokSuite模型不同,我们没有发现词汇大小与模型性能之间的任何重要关系(p=0.407 p=0.407;结果见附录D.3.1.).
这种差异的一个原因可能是,虽然TokSuite的活字符号在许多方面不同,而VISTA活字符号则只在词汇大小上不同.

blocks.en: To answer this question, we test for a correlation between model performance and individual intrinsic tokenizer metrics, following Ali et al. (2024) . In the main analysis, we test correlation with task performance, which we normalized by first z-scoring the accuracy scores within each language-task combination (e.g. the Turkish subset of Global MMLU). We test for a correlation across all task scores. We report all correlations between individual metrics and tasks in Appendix E .

blocks.en: We find that for several of the tasks that we evaluate our models on, a large number of models perform at- or near-chance, especially the smaller models. We conduct an additional analysis after excluding these tasks, which we describe in Appendix F . The results are qualitatively the same.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,对于我们评价模型的几项任务来说, 大量的模型表现在或接近, 特别是较小的模型。 在排除这些任务之后,我们再进行一次分析,我们在附录F中对此作了说明。 结果在质量上是一样的。

blocks.en: We find that 13 of the 29 tokenizer metrics are significantly correlated with z-scored model performance, across all tasks, languages, and model suites. The metrics with the strongest correlations are leading_space_tokens_count ( r = 0.27 r=0.27 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) 9 9 9 All p-values in this paper have a Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons, unless otherwise noted. We report corrected and uncorrected p-values in Appendix E . , used_in_merges ( r = 0.24 r=0.24 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and leading_space_tokens_share ( r = 0.22 r=0.22 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). These are relatively weak correlations.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在29个标语度量度中,有13个与Z分数模型性能密切相关,涉及所有任务、语言和模型套件。 具有最强相关性的度量衡是: leader_space_tokens_count (r = 0.27 r = 0.27, p < 0.001 p < 0.001) 9 9 9 本文中的所有p值都有Bonferroni校正,以进行多项比较,除非另有说明. 我们在附录E中报告经更正和未更正的p值,使用:-in_merges(r = 0.24 r = 0.24,p < 0.001 p < 0.001),并领导:-space_tokens_share(r = 0.22 r = 0.22,p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ),两者的相关性相对薄弱。

blocks.en:
We found that each metric had a wide range of correlation strengths and directions across all tasks and languages.
While there are instances where there are strong correlations between a metric and an individual task, no patterns hold across all languages, tasks, and model suites.
In Figure 1 , we plot the distribution of correlations between each tokenizer metric and individual tasks. We note that almost all tokenizer metrics (including the three metrics with the strongest overall correlations) have at least one task for which there is a moderate ( r > 0.5 r>0.5 ) positive correlation and another task for which there is a moderate negative correlation. Not only do the magnitude of the correlations vary by task, but also the direction.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,每个衡量标准在所有任务和语言中具有广泛的相关优势和方向。
虽然有时衡量任务和个别任务之间有很强的相互关系,但所有语文、任务和模范套件之间没有规律。

blocks.en: We test how much of the variance can be accounted for simply by model size (in number of total parameters), and find that while for 23 of the metrics, it significantly improves model fit for a linear regression above and beyond model size, the maximum increased variance explained is negligible ( R 2 = 0.021 R^{2}=0.021 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). If we look at the correlations between metrics and tasks within a single language and a single model suite, there are some trends.

Figure 2 , left, and Figure 3 ), the strength of the correlations varies greatly but the direction of the correlation largely holds in aggregate. Considering individual tasks, the correlations are not consitent. For example SLOPE_zipf is positively correlated with MultiBLiMP in English, but negatively correlated in Italian for the TokSuite models. Comparing across model suites, the correlations can change again, e.g. SLOPE_zipf is negatively correlated with MultiBLiMP in English with the VISTA models (Figure 2 , right). This supports the aggregate analysis that the correlations are unstable across models, tasks, and languages.
blocks.zh: 在模型套间内部和不同语言之间进行比较(参考图2左侧和图3),关联的强度差异很大,但相关方向大体上是合计的。 考虑单个任务,关联性并不复杂. 例如SLOPE_zipf在英语中与MultiBLIMP是正相联的,但在TokSuite模型中意大利语是负相联的. 对比跨型号套房,关联性可以再次改变,例如. SLOPE_zipf在英语中与多BLIMP和VISTA模型(图2,右)呈负相关. 这支持了综合分析,即模型,任务和语言之间的关联性不稳定.

blocks.en: 6.1 U-statistic
blocks.zh: 6.1 U-统计学

blocks.en: Among TokSuite models, u_mean and u_median are the top-correlated metrics with aggregate English and Turkish performance (Figure 2 and Figure 8 c), outperforming all previously proposed intrinsic metrics. For TIMTC, boundary statistics remain among the more strongly correlated metrics, though with weaker effect sizes. However, for VISTA, U-statistics show almost no relationship with performance. All three suites control for architecture, yet the U-statistic’s predictive power varies substantially across them, suggesting that the relationship between linguistic alignment and downstream performance depends on other properties of training.
blocks.zh: 在TokSuite模型中,u_mean和u_median是具有英语和土耳其语总性能的顶级参数(图2和图8c),比以前提出的所有内在参数都好. 就TIMTC而言,边界统计仍然是比较密切相关的衡量标准之一,尽管效果较小。 然而,对于VISTA来说,U-统计学显示与性能几乎没有关系. 所有三套套房对建筑的控制,然而U-统计学的预测力在它们之间差别很大,说明语言相接与下游性能之间的关系取决于训练的其他属性.

blocks.en: The metric is also language-dependent (Table 1 ). Alphabetic languages cluster around u ¯ ≈ 2.4 \bar{u}\approx 2.4 , while Chinese and Farsi are ∼ 2.7 × {\sim}2.7\times higher ( u ¯ ≈ 6.4 \bar{u}\approx 6.4 ) and show no correlation with performance. Decomposing the U-statistic into its components explains this gap. In alphabetic scripts, most adjacent character pairs within tokens have moderate cohesion, so the PMI min \text{PMI}_{\min} bottleneck is sensitive to tokenization quality: a bad split produces a low-PMI pair that drags the score down. In Chinese, characters are meaning-bearing units that combine productively, yielding uniformly high character-pair PMI; the bottleneck rarely binds, so all tokenizers score similarly. Boundary entropy (BE) is more variable across tokenizers (std 0.26–0.50). Hu et al. (2025) originally developed these signals for Chinese pre-tokenization, where local contrasts in PMI and entropy effectively identify word boundaries, but aggregated across a tokenizer’s full vocabulary, these contrasts wash out. Token frequencies-weighted variants ( u_mean_weighted , u_mean_log_weighted ) do not resolve this, as the issue lies in the underlying character statistics rather than the aggregation; language-specific tuning of λ \lambda could help if the two components degrade unevenly across scripts, but we leave this to future work.

blocks.en: The U-statistic captures a complementary dimension of morphological alignment, whether tokens correspond to coherent character sequences with natural boundaries, using only unsupervised character statistics, without requiring morphological annotations. In settings where it has discriminative power, it outperforms previously proposed metrics. However, its predictive power varies across model suites and breaks down for writing systems where character-level co-occurrence statistics lack the structure the metric relies on. These results suggest that linguistically grounded metrics are a promising direction for tokenizer evaluation, but that their effectiveness is likely to depend on model family and language.
blocks.zh: U-统计法捕捉了形态相通的互补维度,无论指向符是否对应有自然边界的连贯的特征序列,只使用无监督的特征统计,而不需要形态说明. 在它具有歧视性力量的环境下,它的表现超过了以前提出的衡量标准。 然而,它的预测力因模型套件而异,为写作系统而分解,其中字符级共生统计缺乏衡量标准所依赖的结构. 这些结果表明,基于语言的衡量标准是象征性评价的一个有希望的方向,但其有效性可能取决于家庭和语言模式。

blocks.en: 6.2 Summary
blocks.zh: 6.2 总结

blocks.en:
Together these results show the lack of consistency of the tokenizer metrics to reliably predict model performance across different model suites, tasks, and languages.
Because the results are not only different between languages but also between models, we argue that none of the intrinsic tokenizer evaluations is able to reliably predict model performance.
blocks.zh:
这些结果共同表明,标语指标缺乏一致性,无法可靠地预测不同模型套件、任务和语言的模型性能。
由于结果不仅在语言之间不同,在模型之间也不同,所以我们争辩说,内在的表征评价没有一个能够可靠地预测模型性能.

blocks.en: 7 Combining Metrics Does Not Improve Prediction
blocks.zh: 7 合并计量不改进预测

blocks.en:
Here we ask whether combining multiple metrics can better predict downstream performance.
We find that many of the metrics are correlated with each other, which suggests that many of the metrics may be identifying similar or related tokenizer features.
We test whether any combination of metrics better predicts performance across all languages. We fit linear regressions with all combinations of two metrics. We find that although combinations significantly improve model fit, the joint R 2 never exceeds 0.09 0.09 , and the gain in R 2 never exceeds 0.01 0.01 . Therefore, combining two intrinsic tokenizer evaluations does not seem to meaningfully help predict model performance.
Additional results and statistical tests are reported in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们问,结合多种衡量标准是否能够更好地预测下游的业绩。
我们发现,许多度量衡是相互关联的,这表明许多度量衡可能正在识别出类似或相干地标特征.
我们检验任何组合的度量衡是否能更好地预测所有语言的性能. 我们把线性回归与两个度量的所有组合结合起来。 我们发现,虽然组合大大改进了模型适配性,但联合R2从未超过0.090.09,R2中的收益从未超过0.010.01. 因此,合并两项内在的象征性评价似乎无助于预测模型绩效。
附录E.2报告了其他结果和统计测试。

blocks.en: 8 Orthographic Tasks Are Weak Predictors
blocks.zh: 8个正版任务是弱预测器

blocks.en:
Here we analyze whether there is a relationship between orthographic tasks and general model performance. In this analysis, we focus on the TokSuite models, as the other models achieve near-zero performance at most of these tasks. We test whether the orthographic tasks are correlated with any of the downstream tasks or aggregated model performance.
Only TokSuite (English) shows a significant correlation with downstream task performance ( r = 0.341 , p = 0.029 r=0.341,p=0.029 ), though the correlation is relatively weak. The other tasks are all not significantly correlated. We report the results in Appendix E.1 .
These results call into question whether these tasks should be used to shape tokenizer selection and design.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们分析正图任务和一般模型性能之间是否有关系. 在这个分析中,我们侧重于TokSuite模型,因为其他模型在大多数这些任务上都实现了近于零的性能. 我们测试整形任务是否与下游的任何任务相关,或者综合模型性能.
只有TokSuite(英语)显示出与下游任务性能的显著关联性(r=0.341,p=0.029 r=0.341,p=0.029),尽管相关性能相对薄弱. 其他任务并非都密切相关。 我们在附录E.1中报告结果。
这些结果使人怀疑这些任务是否应该用来塑造标致器的选择和设计.

blocks.en: 9 Discussion
blocks.zh: 9 讨论情况

blocks.en: While some tokenizer metrics correlate with individual tasks for some models, there is no clear pattern. We demonstrated that tokenizers affect model performance (Section 5 ), but none of the proposed tokenizer evaluations correlates with performance. We find that using two metrics instead of one does not improve predictive power. Based on these results, we would predict that testing for a correlation between a tokenizer metric and performance on a small number of tasks—especially in a single language or in one family of models—may often result in a significant result. However, our analysis suggests that those results are unlikely to generalize to additional tasks, languages, and model families.
blocks.zh: 虽然有些指标与某些模型的个别任务相关,但没有明确的模式。 我们证明,标注剂影响模型性能(第5节),但拟议的标注剂评价没有一项与性能相关。 我们认为,使用两个指标而不是一个指标并不能提高预测力。 根据这些结果,我们将预测,在少数任务上,特别是在单一语言或一个模型家族中,对象征性的衡量尺度和性能之间的关联性进行测试,往往会产生重大结果。 然而,我们的分析表明,这些结果不大可能被归纳为更多的任务、语言和模范家庭。

blocks.en: The current approach to intrinsic tokenizer evaluation currently does not allow us to determine which tokenizer will result in a better model. More work is needed to be able to determine what an optimal tokenizer looks like and how to identify it.
blocks.zh: 目前对内在象征性评价采取的办法,使我们无法确定哪一种象征性评价将产生更好的模式。 还需要做更多的工作,才能确定最佳的标致器是什么样子以及如何识别它。

blocks.en:
We have focused on the impact of tokenization on model performance. There are other ways in which tokenizers affect language models.
Tokenizers in part determine the speed and cost of model training ( Ahia et al., 2023 ; Petrov et al., 2023 ; Dagan et al., 2024 ; Ali et al., 2024 ; Asgari et al., 2025 ) , because they determine how many computations are needed for a model to process a given text. Therefore compression may be a useful metric, even if it does not correlate with downstream performance.
Relatedly, tokenizer evaluation could help identify unused or under-used tokens in the vocabulary that may lead to undertrained tokens and subsequently undesirable model behavior ( Land and Bartolo, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们侧重于象征性化对模型性能的影响。 标致器影响语言模型还有其他方法.
Tokenizers部分决定了模型训练的速度和成本(Ahia等,2023;Petrov等,2023;Dagan等,2024;Ali等,2024;Asgari等,2025),因为他们决定了模型处理给定文本需要多少计算. 因此,压缩可能是一个有用的衡量标准,即使它与下游的性能无关。
与此相关,象征性评价有助于识别词汇中未使用或使用不足的标志,这些标志可能导致未得到充分训练的标志,以及随后的不良模式行为(Land and Bartolo, 2024 ).

blocks.en: Another dimension is multilingual parity. Ideally, tokenizers can contribute to more balanced multilingual performance ( Petrov et al., 2023 ; Ahia et al., 2023 ) . By better understanding how tokenization impacts languages differently ( Arnett et al., 2025a , e.g. ), we can find ways to develop more balanced tokenizers ( Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ; Foroutan et al., 2026 , e.g. ).
blocks.zh: 另一个层面是多种语文的平等。 理想的情况是,标语可以促进更加平衡的多语种表现(Petrov等,2023;Ahia等,2023.). 通过更好地理解象征性化如何对语言产生不同影响(Arnett等,2025a等),我们可以找到开发更平衡的象征性化剂的方法(Limisiewicz等,2024;Foroutan等,2026等).

blocks.en:
We do not exhaustively analyze the effect of different tokenizer design decisions, but we do discuss the effect of vocabulary size in Section 5 .
Vocabulary size is one of the parameters that can be set for a tokenizer, but which is usually chosen with little rationale ( Alqahtani et al., 2026 ) . Tao et al. (2024) find that most model scales benefit from increased vocabulary, suggesting a bigger-is-better principle for vocabulary size.
However, for the small models used in this study, at a scale where changes in vocabulary size have a large proportional impact on the number of trainable parameters, we do not find a robust effect across our model suites.
Alongside developing better tokenizer evaluations, we need to develop a better understanding of how different design decisions impact model performance.
blocks.zh:
我们并未详尽分析不同符号设计决定的效果,
词汇大小(Vobulary system)是可被设定为标注符的参数之一,但通常选取时没有多少理由(Alqahtani等,2026.). Tao等 (2024年)发现大多数模型尺度都得益于词汇的增加,为词汇大小建议了一个更大的-is-更好的原则.
然而,对于本研究中采用的小型模型,在词汇大小变化对可训练参数数量有较大成正比影响的规模上,我们并没有发现在我们模型套间间间产生强大的效果.
在进行更好的象征性评价的同时,我们需要更好地了解不同的设计决定如何影响模型的业绩。

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en: We have conducted, to the best of our knowledge, the most comprehensive study about the relationship between intrinsic tokenizer metrics and downstream model performance. We find that none of these intrinsic measures reliably predicts model performance and we call for a novel approach to tokenizer evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们以我们所知的最好情况,对内在示意剂指标和下游模型性能之间的关系进行了最全面的研究。 我们发现,这些内在措施中没有一个能够可靠地预测模型的性能,我们要求采取一种新颖的方法来进行象征性的评价。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Each of the model suites we use has its own limitations. TokSuite was trained on tokenizers from existing models, which vary in a number of dimensions: each was trained on a different mix of data, the tokenizers vary in vocabulary size, and many aspects of the tokenization algorithm are different including pretokenization and normalization. Therefore in our analyses, we are unable to completely account for each of these variables which may influence the resulting model’s performance.
The TIMTC models include only models trained on English, therefore we are unable to determine to what extent any patterns may generalize to other languages.
Finally, the VISTA models are trained in a controlled way and are trained for multiple languages. However, they are much smaller than the models in the other suites.
None of these model suites is able to definitively address the research questions because of these limitations. However, putting these models together and comparing across suites helps us to address some of the weaknesses of the models.
blocks.zh:
我们使用的每一个模型套房都有自己的局限性. TokSuite接受过来自现有模型的活化剂的培训,这些活化剂在多个维度上有所不同:每个活化剂都接受过不同组合数据的培训,活化剂的活化剂在词汇大小上有所不同,活化算法的许多方面是不同的,包括先入为主和常态. 因此,在我们的分析中,我们无法完全说明可能影响模型的性能的每个变量。
TIMTC模式只包括英语培训的模型,因此我们无法确定任何模式在多大程度上可以通通到其他语言.
最后,VISTA模型以可控方式得到训练并接受多种语言的培训. 然而,它们比其他套房的模型小得多.
由于这些限制,这些示范套房中没有一个能够明确解决研究问题。 然而,把这些模型组合起来,并进行套间比较,有助于我们解决模型的一些弱点。

blocks.en: In our study, we studied models of a variety of sizes, including models up to 1B parameters. That said, our smaller models are generally not very strong. They achieved near-chance performance at several tasks. Analyzing models with poor performance may not provide the same signal as larger models trained on more tokens may provide. We address the effects of poor task performance on our results in Appendix F . Additionally, we highlight that small differences in performance at smaller scales still represent differences in performance that intrinsic tokenizer evaluation should seek to predict and explain.
blocks.zh: 在我们的研究中,我们研究了各种大小的模型,包括可达1B参数的模型. 尽管如此,我们较小的模型一般并不十分强大。 他们在若干任务中取得了近乎出色的业绩。 分析性能不佳的模型可能不会提供与接受过更多代币培训的更大型模型可能提供的相同信号. 在附录F中,我们述及工作业绩不佳对我们的成果的影响。 此外,我们强调,规模较小的绩效方面的小差异仍然代表着绩效方面的小差异,而内在的象征性评价应力求预测和解释。

blocks.en: The benchmarks we used to evaluate model performance varied across languages. Some languages had more available benchmarks than others, and these benchmarks vary in size and quality. Additionally, some of the intrinsic tokenizer evaluations relied on annotated data. The chunkability data from Beinborn and Pinter (2023) is only available in English. There is also not sufficient labeled data to calculate MorphScore for Vietnamese. The lack of evaluations in languages other than English is a widespread issue in the field and limits our analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们用来评价示范业绩的基准因语文而异。 有些语文比其他语文有更多的可用基准,这些基准在大小和质量上各不相同。 此外,一些内在的象征性评价依靠附加说明的数据。 Beinborn和Pinter(2023年)提供的可拆分性数据只有英语版本. 也没有足够的被贴上标签的数据来计算越南语的莫菲斯分数. 除英文外,没有其他语文的评价是外地普遍存在的问题,限制了我们的分析。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work aims to improve the understanding of the impact of tokenization across multiple settings, including multiple languages. We are not aware of any potential risks or negative impacts of this work. In fact, we hope this work improves the understanding of how design decisions may not affect all languages equally.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在增进对包括多语种在内的多种环境的象征性化影响的认识。 我们不知道这项工作有任何潜在风险或负面影响。 事实上,我们希望这项工作能使人们更好地了解设计决定如何不会平等地影响所有语文。

blocks.en: A.2 Zipfianness Metrics

blocks.en:
Word frequency distributions in natural language follow Zipf’s law ( Zipf, 1949 ) , which states that the frequency of a word is inversely proportional to its rank: f ⁡ ( r ) ∝ r − α f(r)\propto r^{-\alpha} where r r is the rank and α ≈ 1 \alpha\approx 1 .
This pattern holds across languages ( Piantadosi, 2014 ) . On a log-log plot, a perfect Zipfian distribution appears as a straight line with slope − 1 -1 .

这种模式贯穿各种语言(Piantadosi,2014年)。 在一个日志图上,一个完美的Zipfian分布作为有斜-1-1的直线出现.

blocks.en:
Recent work has shown that tokenizers whose frequency distributions adhere more closely to Zipf’s law tend to yield better downstream model performance, particularly in multilingual settings ( Lotz et al., 2025 ) .
The intuition is that tokenizers yielding token distributions closely aligned with a Zipfian power law may be better suited for modeling natural language.
Following Lotz et al. (2025) , we compute three metrics on the log-log rank-frequency curve. Following evidence that power laws only apply above some minimum rank ( Clauset et al., 2009 ) , we restrict our analysis to tokens with log ⁡ ( rank ) ≤ 6 \log(\text{rank})\leq 6 .

blocks.en: A.5 Cognitive Plausibility

blocks.en:
Following Beinborn and Pinter (2023) , we evaluate tokenizers through the lens of cognitive plausibility by correlating tokenizer behavior with human lexical decision performance.
We use the British Lexicon Project ( Keuleers et al., 2012 ) , which contains lexical decision data (reaction time and accuracy) for 28,730 English words.
Chunkability measures how aggressively a tokenizer segments a word: Chunkability ​ ( w ) = 1 − # tokens for word ​ w # characters in ​ w \text{Chunkability}(w)=1-\frac{\text{\# tokens for word }w}{\text{\# characters in }w} Chunkability ranges from 0 (each character is a separate token) to values approaching 1 (the word is kept as a single token).
Higher chunkability indicates that the tokenizer treats the word as a more cohesive unit.
We compute Pearson correlations between chunkability and three human performance measures:
(1) mean reaction time (RT), the average time in milliseconds participants take to decide whether a letter string is a valid word—faster responses indicate easier processing;
(2) z-scored reaction time, which normalizes RT within each participant to control for individual differences in baseline speed, providing a more reliable measure of relative processing difficulty; and
(3) accuracy percentage, the proportion of correct responses for each word.

The TIMTC (Tokenization Is More Than Compression) models from Schmidt et al. (2024) consist of 350M parameter decoder-only language models trained on the Pile corpus.

blocks.en: B.2 TokSuite
blocks.zh: B.2 托克套间

blocks.en:
The TokSuite models from Altıntaş et al. (2025) are designed to isolate the impact of tokenizer choice on language model behavior.
The suite consists of 14 models sharing identical architecture, training data, compute budget, and initialization, differing only in their tokenizer.
Tokenizers are drawn from popular open-source models including GPT-2, BERT, Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Aya, BLOOM, XGLM, Tekken, GPT-4o, Comma, and TokenMonster, as well as the byte-level ByT5 tokenizer.
This controlled setup enables direct comparison of tokenizer effects on downstream performance across English and multilingual tasks.

来自Altıntaş等人(2025年)的TokSuite模型旨在隔离标语选择对语言模型行为的影响.
该套房由14个模式组成,共享相同的架构,培训数据,计算预算,并初始化,仅在其标注符上有所不同.

这种控制下的设置可以直接比较各种英语和多语种任务对下游表现的影响。

blocks.en: We train two families of LLAMA 1 Touvron et al. (2023) language models: • VISTA-130M ( ∼ \sim 130M parameters, comparable to GPT-1 Radford et al. (2018) ): 12 layers, hidden size 768, 12 attention heads. • VISTA-350M ( ∼ \sim 350M parameters): 24 layers, hidden size 1024, 16 attention heads. Both architectures use SiLU activations, RoPE positional embeddings, a maximum sequence length of 1024, and RMS normalization ( ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon{=}10^{-6} ). The embedding and language modeling head dimensions are adjusted to match each vocabulary size; all other hyperparameters are held fixed across tokenizers. Our implementation is built on the codebase of Sun et al. (2025) using the Hugging Face Transformers library Wolf et al. (2020) . Table 7 details the full model and training configurations for the 130M and 350M scales, respectively. Note that the parameter sizes for both families vary significantly with the vocabulary sizes.

blocks.en: B.3.2 Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: B.3.2 超参数

blocks.en: For the 130M models, we closely follow the pre-training protocol from Chang et al. (2026) . All 130M models are trained for 10 epochs on their respective BP-scaled monolingual training data, following evidence that multiple-epoch pre-training is beneficial for smaller datasets Muennighoff et al. (2023) . We use a global batch size of 512 and apply attention dropout (0.1) to mitigate overfitting, with gradient clipping disabled (following Chang et al. (2026) ).
blocks.zh: 对于130M型号,我们密切关注从常等(2026年)发出的预训规程. 所有130M模型都为10个纪元接受了各自BP尺度的单一语言培训数据的培训,此前有证据表明多纪元前培训对更小的数据集Muennighoff等人(2023年)有益. 我们使用512个全球批量规模,并采用失能(0.1)来缓解过度适应,而梯度剪接则被禁用(跟随张等 (2026年))。

blocks.en: For the 350M models, we train on substantially larger data: the English models are trained for 1 epoch on the Chinchilla-optimal 7 billion tokens from FineWeb Penedo et al. (2024) , while non-English models are trained on equivalent bytes of FineWeb-2 Penedo et al. (2025) data scaled by the language-specific byte premium. The global batch size remains at 512, with gradient clipping enabled, and attention dropout removed. For fair comparison, all configurations within each model scale are held constant across languages and vocabulary sizes.
blocks.zh: 对于350M型号,我们的培训数据要大得多:英语型号在FineWeb Penedo等人(2024年)的Chinchilla-优化70亿令牌上的1个纪元上接受了培训;而非英语型号则接受FineWeb-2 Penedo等人(2025年)等同字节的训练,数据由语言特有字节溢价缩放. 全球批量规模仍为512个,可进行梯度剪接,并取消注意力。 为了进行公平的比较,每个模型尺度内的所有配置在语言和词汇大小之间保持不变。

blocks.en: B.3.3 Data
blocks.zh: B.3.3 数据

blocks.en: We utilize monolingual datasets from Chang et al. (2026) , covering five languages: English ( eng_latn ), Thai ( tha_thai ), Urdu ( urd_arab ), Amharic ( amh_ethi ), and Vietnamese ( vie_latn ). Training splits are defined by Byte Premium (BP) scaling, such that each language contributes an information-theoretically equivalent amount of data (approximately 1 GB × \times the Byte Premium). The BP multipliers are derived from Arnett et al. (2024a) and detailed in Table 6 . Evaluation splits consist of the disjoint last (BP-scaled) 8,000 lines of each monolingual dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自Chang等人(2026年)的单一语言数据集,涵盖五种语言:英语(eng_latn),泰语(tha_thai),乌尔都语(urd_arab),阿姆哈拉语(amh_ethi),越南语(vie_latn). 训练分数由Byte Premium(BP)缩放来定义,这样,每种语言都提供了信息理论等量的数据(约1 GB ×\times the Byte Premium). BP乘数取自Arnett等人(2024a),详见表6. 评价划分包括每个单一语言数据集上8 000行的断开连接(BP-scaled)。

blocks.en: At the 350M scale, we follow a Chinchilla-optimal data regime. English models are trained on 7 billion tokens from FineWeb’s 10 Billion token sample Penedo et al. (2024) , yielding approximately 31 GiB of tokenized training data (for vocab size 32,768). For non-English languages, we source data from FineWeb-2 Penedo et al. (2025) and define each language’s training data target as: target_bytes = BP × eng_ref_bytes \texttt{target\_bytes}=\text{BP}\times\texttt{eng\_ref\_bytes} where eng_ref_bytes is the byte size of the 7B-token, tokenized English training file, for that corresponding tokenizer type and vocabulary size. Table 4 details the data budget for the BPE tokenizer at vocabulary size 32,768 (this is representative; the same BP-scaling procedure is applied per tokenizer/vocabulary combination with respect to the corresponding English reference).

blocks.en: Not all languages have sufficient data in FineWeb-2 to meet the BP-scaled target. Amharic has only 2.69 GiB of raw text—less than 5% of the required ∼ {\sim} 54 GiB (tokenized)—and was excluded from 350M training to avoid severe overfitting. Urdu has approximately 25% of the required data; we compensate with multi-epoch training (3–4 × \times depending on tokenizer/vocabulary), which converged well empirically. Thai and Vietnamese have ample data in FineWeb-2 and are trained for a single epoch.

blocks.en: B.3.4 Compute Costs
blocks.zh: B.3.4 计算费用

blocks.en: All VISTA models are trained on 4 or 8 NVIDIA H100/A100 GPUs in bfloat16 mixed precision.
blocks.zh: 所有VISTA型号在bfloat16混合精度上被训练出4或8个NVIDIA H100/A100GPU.

blocks.en: Each 130M model is trained for 10 epochs on the BP-scaled datasets ( ∼ {\sim} 1–2.7 GB per language). Wall-clock time per run ranges between 2 and 3 hours ( ∼ {\sim} 8–12 GPU-hours). The full 130M experimental suite comprises 80 runs (5 languages × \times 2 tokenizers × \times 8 vocabulary sizes), for a total of 640–960 GPU-hours.

The full 350M suite comprises 16 runs (4 languages × \times 2 tokenizers × \times 2 vocabulary sizes), as detailed in Table 5 .

blocks.en: B.3.5 Language Specific Tokenization
blocks.zh: B.3.5 特定语言化

blocks.en: For both BPE and Unigram variants, tokenizers trained on the corresponding Arnett et al. (2025a) monolingual corpus with varying vocabulary sizes from Arnett et al. (2025a) are used. At the 350M scale, we reuse the same monolingual tokenizers for the FineWeb-2 languages (Thai, Urdu, Vietnamese), as for the 130M experiments (e.g., FineWeb-2 Thai data is tokenized with the same tha_thai tokenizer). All text data is pre-tokenized into integer IDs before training. Each line in the training file corresponds to a sequence of space-separated token integers. Consecutive non-empty lines from the source text are concatenated and packed to fill the maximum sequence length of 1024 tokens. We prepend a CLS token to each packed sequence and append a SEP token after every individual text segment within that sequence. This packing is performed offline with no padding tokens written to disk, ensuring the model sees a continuous stream of data at high throughput. For the 350M English models, the tokenized data is truncated to get the first 7 billion tokens. blocks.en: Figure 12 shows the correlations between each of the intrinsic tokenizer metrics. Within each type of tokenizer evaluation (indicated with black boxes), many metrics are strongly correlated with each other. Outside of those types, there are several other strong correlations. For example both unigram and bigram entropy are strongly correlated with compression metrics, and MorphScore is somewhat correlated with worse compression, as predicted. Many potential relationships emerge in this analysis. So, in the next section, we test whether combining any of these metrics can better predict downstream performance.
